#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export PLOW_MLA_PF_V2=1 PLOW_MLA_PF_AITER=1 PLOW_PF_CHUNK=8192 PLOW_PF_INTERLEAVE=0
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$ROCM_PATH/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
root=/tmp/tp-glm53-row-norm
export PLOW_HSACO_LOWRUNG=""
export PLOW_DSTEP_LOG=0
if [ "$#" = 0 ]; then set -- on off; fi
for arm in "$@"; do
    export PLOW_HSACO="$root/overlay"
    "$root/plowrt" serve --assets "$root/assets-$arm" --port 19000 > "$root/server-$arm.log" 2>&1 &
    server=$!
    trap 'kill -TERM "$server" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$server" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
    ready=0
    for attempt in $(seq 1 180); do
        if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:19000/v1/models > "$root/models-$arm.json" 2>/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
        kill -0 "$server" || exit 1
        sleep 1
    done
    [ "$ready" = 1 ]
    python3 runtime/bench/amd/mla_sparse_aiter/quality.py http://127.0.0.1:19000 "row-norm-$arm" "$root/quality-$arm.json" --concurrency 20 > "$root/quality-$arm.log" 2>&1
    env VLLM_ROCM_LIB=/opt/rocm/core-7.14/lib /app/plow/build-gemma31/vllm-python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main bench serve --backend vllm --host 127.0.0.1 --port 19000 --model glm-5.3-plow-lite --tokenizer zai-org/GLM-5.3 --trust-remote-code --dataset-name random --num-prompts 20 --random-input-len 70000 --random-output-len 700 --random-range-ratio 0.14 --max-concurrency 20 --save-result --save-detailed --result-dir "$root" --result-filename "serve-$arm.json" > "$root/bench-$arm.log" 2>&1
    kill -TERM "$server"
    wait "$server" || [ "$?" = 143 ]
    trap - EXIT
done

recorder_source:
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).parent
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
source = json.loads((root / 'campaign-source.json').read_text())
assert sha(root / 'plowrt') == source['runtime_sha256']
assert sha(root / 'plowc') == source['compiler_sha256']
assert sha(root / 'campaign.sh') == source['campaign_sha256']
for path, expected in source['source_sha256'].items():
    assert sha(Path(path)) == expected, path
for name, expected in source['objects'].items():
    assert sha(root / 'overlay' / name) == expected, name
arms = {}
results = {}
for arm in ('on', 'off'):
    assert sha(root / f'assets-{arm}/model.pkt') == source['packet_sha256'][arm]
    result = json.loads((root / f'serve-{arm}.json').read_text())
    quality = json.loads((root / f'quality-{arm}.json').read_text())
    assert (result['completed'], result['failed']) == (20, 0)
    assert len(quality['cells']) == 18 and all(c['passed'] for c in quality['cells'])
    results[arm] = result
    arms[arm] = dict(metrics={k: v for k, v in result.items() if not isinstance(v, (list, dict))},
                     quality=quality, input_lens=result['input_lens'], output_lens=result['output_lens'],
                     sha256={p.name: sha(p) for p in (root / f'serve-{arm}.json', root / f'quality-{arm}.json',
                                                       root / f'server-{arm}.log', root / f'bench-{arm}.log')})
for field in ('input_lens', 'output_lens'):
    assert results['on'][field] == results['off'][field]
change = {k: 100 * (results['on'][k] / results['off'][k] - 1)
          for k in ('output_throughput', 'mean_ttft_ms', 'mean_tpot_ms', 'p99_tpot_ms', 'median_itl_ms')}
record = dict(schema='plow.glm.decode-row-norm.v1', date='2026-09-10', artifact_root=str(root),
              campaign_source=source, arms=arms, change_percent=change,
              exact_generated_text_matches=sum(a == b for a, b in zip(results['on']['generated_texts'], results['off']['generated_texts'])),
              recorder_source=Path(__file__).read_text(), recorder_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),
              validation=dict(glm_emitter_tests_passed=38, emit_config_tests_passed=23, packet_tests_passed=123,
                              numerical_cases_passed=80, lean_programs_per_arm=10),
              limitations=[
                  'One ordered on/off 20-request pair; no repeatability estimate and not the full 100-request H200 workload.',
                  'Numerical checks prove the tested norm-body equivalence; retrieval checks do not establish broad model quality.',
                  'The existing no_raw_env_reads configuration lint fails on PLOW_GLM_DSA_PF_SPAN and PLOW_GLM_DSA_PF_DEXACT, both present in the base commit. It was excluded from the subsequent 23-test configuration run.',
                  'Frozen resident runtime and objects; only packet workgroup counts change.',
              ])
Path('runtime/bench/amd/glm_decode_norm/mi300x-serving.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(changes=change, metrics={k: v['metrics'] for k, v in arms.items()}), indent=2))
